overview.noPass: First create your qualification passport – after that you can apply with one click.
overview.noApplications: No applications yet. You can find matching wards in the search.

applications.title: Applications
applications.empty: No applications yet. Find matching wards in the search.
applications.threadHint: Directly with the employer, stored encrypted.
applications.shareDocsHint: Without sharing, the employer only sees the status «verified». You can revoke this at any time.
applications.withdrawBody: The employer will be informed. You will not be able to apply for this job again afterwards.

pass.title: Qualification passport
pass.lead: Verified once, included as a verified block in every application. Employers see original documents only with your consent.
pass.setup: Name, profession, experience and languages are enough for your first application. You can upload diplomas afterwards.
pass.credentialsHint: Diplomas, recognitions, registry entry ({registry}), further education. Reviewed by Kardia within 2 working days at most.
pass.phoneHint: Optional, stored encrypted, visible only after you share it.
pass.noCredentials: No credentials yet. Start by uploading your diploma.
pass.credentialSaved: Credential saved. The review is starting.
pass.resetWarning: This credential is verified. Changes to the details reset the status to «submitted».
pass.registryNumberHint: Stored encrypted, visible only for the review.
pass.file: File (PDF, JPG or PNG, max. 15 MB)
pass.fileHint: Scan or photo of the original.
pass.aiSuggestionAvailable: AI suggestion available – open «Edit» to review it

saved.title: Saved & compare
saved.emptyJobs: Nothing saved yet. Save jobs in the search with the heart.
saved.searchesHint: Notification of new results by email and push.

marketplace.title: Marketplace & offers
marketplace.lead: Set your conditions anonymously. Employers send offers with a concrete annual salary – they only see your name and contact details once you express interest.
marketplace.noOffers: No offers yet. Activate your anonymous profile so that employers can find you.
marketplace.noOffersActive: Your profile is visible. Offers will appear here.
marketplace.profileHint: Visible: profession, specialties, experience, district, workload, must-have conditions, start, passport status. Never: name, photo, year of birth, employer.
marketplace.districtHint: Only the district, never the address.
marketplace.blocksHint: Blocked institutions cannot see your profile.
marketplace.anonymity: No endpoint discloses identifying data from your anonymous profile before you consent.

offer.title: Offer: {job}
offer.closed: This offer is no longer open.
offer.interestHint: If you are interested, you share your name and contact details; you then continue in the application thread.
offer.reason: Reason for declining (optional, only visible in aggregate)

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.lead: Individual shifts from your flex pools. You are employed by the respective employer; Kardia is only the software.
shifts.openHint: Book with a single tap; confirmation sent to both sides.
shifts.noOpen: No open shifts in your pools at the moment.
shifts.cancelDeadline: Cancellation only up to {hours} h before – after that, directly with the employer.
shifts.interestSent: Interest registered. The employer will choose.

training.title: Postgraduate training
training.lead: Enter the years you have completed in each area. Kardia shows jobs that close your gap to the specialist title.
training.noJobs: No job with creditable postgraduate training for this title at the moment. Save the search to be notified.

team.title: My ward
team.noWards: You are not yet assigned to any ward as an employee.
team.questionsHint: Your answers appear without your name after moderation.
team.answerHint: Up to 1'500 characters, factual and without names of individuals.
team.answered: Thank you! The answer will appear after moderation.

settings.title: Settings
settings.notificationsHint: New results, status changes, offers, shifts and reminders 12 h before a shift.
settings.pushUnsupported: This browser does not support push notifications. You will still receive emails.
settings.pushOn: Push notifications are active on this device.
settings.pushOff: Push notifications are off on this device.
settings.passkeysHint: Sign in without a password, with your fingerprint or device.
settings.noPasskeys: No passkey yet. Add one to sign in faster.
settings.passkeyFailed: The passkey could not be added. Try again.
settings.dataHint: Export as JSON at any time; deletion is permanent.
settings.deleteBody: Your profile, passport documents, applications and messages are deleted immediately. Employers you have applied to will no longer see the application.
